sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  • Access your WordPress admin.
  • Navigate to Dashboard => Plugins => Add New.
  • Enter “PASS” in the search bar.
  • Click “Install” and then “Activate”.
  • Visit Productive… => “PASS”, to configure plugin settings.

► For comprehensive installation guidance, please consult the plugin’s documentation. It offers step-by-step instructions for both manual and automatic installations.
sections.faq:
Does it work with my theme?

The plugin is exclusively developed to support our WordPress Themes, the bundled Elementor widgets are compatible with any theme that follows WordPress development guidelines.

Which themes are compatible with this plugin?

This plugin is tailored to be fully compatible with themes developed by productiveminds.com.

Must I use both Elementor and Gutenberg Simultaneously?

No, option is provided to choose the desired page builder. However, both can be used simultaneously. For instance, content can be created with Gutenberg editor while either Elementor widget or Gutenberg block are utilised to design page that use the same content.

Is it compatible with either Elementor or Gutenberg?

Our philosophy with this plugin is that, content are created in WordPress editor, then displayed with user’s favourite page builder, such as Elementor or Gutenberg. So, it works with both simultaneously.

How does this plugin facilitate content creation?

It comes equipped with specialized post types for various content categories, such as testimonials, FAQs, and specific content elements like videos. Once content is created, administrators can effortlessly use tools like Elementor Widgets to display it in diverse formats throughout the site.

How are starter site data imported into my website?

When you import a starter site, its data and content are delivered from our server via a secure web service, ensuring you always receive the latest version. No authentication details are required.
During this process, your website’s home URL and admin email are sent to our server only to verify that the request comes from a valid browser and to prevent hotlinking. This information is not stored.
